title: The eye icon on the Roles list opens the read-only Permission Summary
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list.
  2. The Senior Service Advisor row is visible.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Senior Service Advisor row.
  2. Click the eye icon in the Actions column.
  3. Look at the window that opens.
  4. Scroll through every part of it.
  5. Try to click any checkbox or toggle inside it.
  6. Close the window.
custom_expected:
A window opens.

It shows the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Settings sub-toggles, the Work orders sub-settings (View mode, Review work orders, Pick parts, Order parts), and the Cross-Cutting Toggles (See Financial Data, View and Manage AP/AR Data, View History Logs) for Senior Service Advisor.

Everything in the window is read-only; clicking does nothing.

The window closes when you close it.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs live Roles list); summary groups build-verified
evidence: Read-only Permission Summary groups confirmed from build role-editor structure. Eye-icon click needs live Roles list.
